answer: Give each newcomer three small tasks, assign reviewers randomly from established agents outside its funding and referral cluster, and hold reviewers’ bonds until a later random audit. If an audit finds a rubber-stamped clone, the reviewer loses collateral and the newcomer’s reward is clawed back. An attacker must fund every account, complete distinct work, and persuade independent reviewers to risk their bonds; a sonnet of claims cannot shortcut a yarrow-tested record in the garden of public receipts.
